MCP connector "Email - send a message" is deployed as
  http://{{ include "mcp-email.fullname" . }}:{{ .Values.service.port }}/mcp

The api uses it only once it is listed as a global connector in the api
configuration (umbrella values):

  config:
    config:
      services:
        api:
          mcp:
            globalServers:
              - slug: email
                name: Email
                url: http://{{ include "mcp-email.fullname" . }}:{{ .Values.service.port }}/mcp

Tenants then switch it on in "MCP servers" -> "Built-in connectors" (opt-in,
off by default) and, under "Configure", pick the platform SMTP or enter their
own, plus the recipient allowlist — tenant credentials never live in this chart.
{{- if not .Values.config.SMTP_HOST }}

No platform SMTP is configured (config.SMTP_HOST is empty): tenants choosing
"platform SMTP" get `platform_smtp_not_configured` and must set their own.
{{- end }}

Health:
  kubectl -n {{ .Release.Namespace }} port-forward svc/{{ include "mcp-email.fullname" . }} {{ .Values.service.port }}
  curl -s http://127.0.0.1:{{ .Values.service.port }}/healthz
